claims.claim: Hacked PS4 with 6 games (FC 27, GTA 5, Gran Turismo, Mortal Kombat, God of War, Call of Duty 3)
claims.evidence: Console is fully covered by a camouflage skin with no visible brand, logo, or model markings in any photo; no screen or menu showing installed games is shown.

risks.risk: True identity/brand of console cannot be confirmed because the skin hides all markings
risks.proof: Photo with skin peeled back or a close-up of the PS logo/serial sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/unconfirmed console, worst case

risks.risk: Console power-on and basic functionality unknown
risks.proof: Video of the console being powered on, reaching home screen

risks.risk: 'Hacked' (modded/jailbroken) firmware may be unstable, bannable online, or illegal to resell, and could brick at any update
risks.proof: Video showing the jailbreak menu/loader and a game launching from it
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-risk, unverified modded unit

risks.risk: Claimed games may not actually be installed or may be pirated/non-functional copies
risks.proof: Screen recording scrolling through the game library launching at least one title

risks.risk: Hidden shell damage, cracks, or missing ports under the camouflage skin wrap
risks.proof: Photo with skin removed showing full console shell

risks.risk: Controller battery health and wireless/charging function unverified
risks.proof: Video of controller charging, syncing, and responding to inputs

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or box shown as included
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and packaging laid out

risks.risk: Storage capacity (HDD/SSD size) unknown, affecting value
risks.proof: Photo of system storage settings screen

proof_requests: Photo with the camouflage skin peeled back showing PS logo and serial number
Video of the console powering on to the home screen
Video showing the hacked/jailbreak loader and one game launching
Screen recording of the full game library with at least one title played briefly
Photo of all included cables and any box/packaging
Photo of system storage settings showing capacity
Video of controller pairing, charging, and button response test
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a console-and-controller set, so it can be priced, but brand/model, hacked status, included games, and functionality are all unverifiable from the photos and must be priced at worst case until proven.
